objectively judge whether a newly generated mathematical equation is

The objective is to evolve the tracer velocity over time.

[VARIABLES & PARAMETERS]:
- Target variable: dv_dt (rate of change of the tracer drift velocity)
- Input features: t (time)
- Dynamic states: v (drift velocity of the suspended tracer); T_local (local excess temperature of the fluid layer entrained around the tracer)
- Parameters: F_drive (applied driving force on the tracer); drag_coeff (linear viscous drag coefficient at reference temperature); tracer_mass (effective inertial mass of the tracer); quad_drag_coeff (quadratic (inertial/form) drag coefficient); added_mass_coeff (dimensionless added-mass (virtual mass) coefficient); rho_fluid (mass density of the surrounding liquid metal); volume_scale (displaced-fluid volume scale of the tracer); shear_thin_scale (velocity scale controlling shear-rate reduction of entrained fluid); drag_thermal_coeff (sensitivity of viscous drag to local temperature (thermal thinning of viscosity)); visc_heating_coeff (rate of viscous-dissipation heating of the entrained layer per unit drag power); thermal_relax_rate (thermal relaxation rate of the entrained layer back to bulk temperature); thermal_advect_coeff (advective enhancement of thermal relaxation with tracer speed (convective clearing of the entrained layer)); buoyant_convect_coeff (strength of buoyancy-driven convective heat removal that grows nonlinearly with layer overheating)

[CANDIDATE EQUATION]:
dv_dt = (F_drive - drag_coeff*v*(1 + drag_thermal_coeff*T_local) - quad_drag_coeff*v*Abs(v)) / (tracer_mass + added_mass_coeff*rho_fluid*volume_scale/(1 + shear_thin_scale*Abs(v)))
